card.name: Commas in lists of clinical findings
card.fires_on: Commas that separate items in a short list of clinical terms, such as after 'airway' or 'hypotension' in overdose management text. Also the degree sign in '38°C' fever definitions.

modes.label: List commas
modes.description: A comma after one item in a list of physiological problems or care measures, with more items following.
modes.example: An adequate airway<<,>> oxygenation and ventilation should be ensured;

modes.label: Temperature unit
modes.description: The °C mark right after a threshold temperature number in severity definitions.
modes.example: Severe defined as temperature ≥ 38<<°C>> with Hemodynamic instability requiring a vasop

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward the next list item, but the promoted tokens are mostly non-English and give no clear picture.
card.plain: It fires on the comma between items in a list of overdose findings or care steps, and on the °C after a fever cutoff.
